name: DS Electronics, Inc.
old_description: DS Electronics has been a leader in PCB assembly and electronic contract manufacturing services since the 1990s. As a second-generation family-owned and operated company, product quality and trusted relationships in the industry are of the highest value to us.
about:
DS Electronics, Inc. is a second-generation family-owned contract manufacturer based in Gilbert, Arizona. The company was started in the early 1990s by Don Stemple in nearby Tempe and has since transitioned to leadership by Stemple and his children—Will Stemple as Vice President of Finance and Andy Stemple as Vice President of Engineering—alongside General Manager Don Becker.

The firm specializes in PCB assembly and full electronic contract manufacturing, offering services that span new product development, high-volume production, box-build assembly, test engineering, supply-chain management, and quality assurance. Its Gilbert facility runs six independent SMT lines equipped with multiple reflow ovens, pick-and-place machines capable of placing 0201 components and fine-pitch BGAs, robotic selective-solder and wave-solder systems, and both 3D and 2D automated optical inspection stations. The operation supports prototype runs through high-volume commercial production.

DS Electronics serves customers in LED lighting, semiconductor manufacturing, industrial electronics, and automotive sectors. Clients range from early-stage design teams needing engineering guidance to established OEMs requiring large-scale, repeatable builds.

The company cites product quality and relationships as its founding principles, emphasizing engineering-led design support that often enhances customer specifications. Integrated box-build services—including electro-mechanical assembly, conformal coating, and functional testing—aim to reduce supply-chain steps for clients.

name: DSI Manufacturing
old_description: DSI’s goal is to establish long term partnerships with our customers. We do this by following the DSI Proven Process:
about:
DSI Manufacturing operates from Rogers, Minnesota, where it was founded in 1982. The company is led by President Joe Hines and has grown over four decades into a precision metal fabrication and CNC machining specialist.

The shop runs two facilities totaling more than 80,000 square feet, equipped for sheet metal fabrication — laser cutting, stamping, forming, welding, powder coating, and full assembly — as well as advanced CNC machining including 3-, 4-, and 5-axis milling (HAAS VF3SS and VF4), Swiss turning, surface grinding, and finishing. An in-house powder coating line uses Parker Ionics systems and Rapid Engineering ovens, while a dedicated Rapid Response Cell turns prototypes and short-run jobs around in days.

DSI serves industries ranging from retail fixtures and displays to machinery, electronics, communications, automotive and recreational vehicles, oil and energy, agriculture, fluid handling and filtration, medical, and construction. Its customer base includes global retailers and technology firms that rely on quick-turn lightweight metal and plastic components.

The company emphasizes its DSI Proven Process, which combines collaborative design-for-manufacturability engineering, ISO 9001:2015 certified quality management, and a 'Can-Do' culture focused on fast-paced execution. In-house finishing, rapid prototyping, and a commitment to on-time delivery are cited as key differentiators.

name: Daddy's Workshop of the Carolinas
old_description: Our lives are filled with all sorts of products, most of which come from the cogs of mass production, from a faraway land with little connection to people or place. This type of existence disconnects us from one another, how things are made & where they come from. I’d like to remedy that problem by reconnecting you to the human touch of natural materials. In an age where many things exist only in digital worlds, I hearken back to a more human time with natural wood worked & styled by a craftsman. You deserve something better than crumbling particle-board furniture. We can design from scratch, or work from a picture. I work mostly in the Craftsman & Shaker styles; furniture traditions that reflect an honest, solid way of life. Take a tour of my shop & furniture projects with the video & slideshow below. Coupled with making fine furniture, I also restore vintage machinery, with its elegant design & robust quality. From Grandma knitting in her rocker, to a child building with blocks by the fireplace, there is something deeply satisfying & richly human about creating things by hand. Join me in this long tradition of treasuring the physicality & humanness of working wood one piece at a time.
about:
Daddy's Workshop of the Carolinas operates from Lancaster, South Carolina, where founder Joshua Pauling runs a one-person woodworking studio alongside his roles as vicar, headmaster, and teacher at All Saints Lutheran Church and All Saints Classical Academy. The workshop began as an extension of Pauling's personal commitment to handcrafted quality, though a specific founding year is not publicly documented.

The shop produces custom furniture pieces using solid natural wood, focusing on Craftsman and Shaker designs that emphasize traditional joinery and honest construction. Pauling builds each item to order, either from original designs or from customer-supplied images, and also restores vintage woodworking machinery, returning older equipment to working condition. Output remains at a craft scale, with no published figures for facility size, headcount, or annual volume.

The workshop serves individual clients seeking heirloom-quality furniture and collectors or hobbyists needing vintage machinery restoration. While no specific industry sectors are listed, the work aligns with residential furniture, custom woodworking, and antique tool restoration markets.

Pauling positions the business as a counterpoint to mass-produced, particle-board furniture, arguing that handcrafted pieces reconnect people to the physicality of making and the provenance of materials. The emphasis on natural wood, traditional styles, and the restoration of older machines reflects a stated philosophy of valuing human touch and durability over disposable consumption.

Customers include professional automotive and auto-body repair shops as well as vehicle owners seeking accessories and replacement components. The shuttle service caters specifically to nearby commercial clients.

name: Dakota Automotive Products, Inc
old_description: We provide a service to customers and auto dealerships in eastern South Dakota, southwest Minnesota, northwest Iowa and northeast Nebraska as an expeditor and installer of a full range of leather interiors, seat comfort products and automotive electronic accessories.
about:
Dakota Automotive Products, Inc. operates from Alcester, South Dakota. The company’s founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed. It began as a service provider to auto dealerships and retail customers across eastern South Dakota, southwest Minnesota, northwest Iowa, and northeast Nebraska.

The firm functions as a distributor and installer of automotive aftermarket products. Its portfolio includes leather interior kits, power sunroofs, mobile electronics, remote start systems, rear-seat entertainment, seat comfort systems, advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS), factory OE radio upgrades, and Sirius XM add-on modules. The company acts as an expeditor, sourcing products and managing installation for its clients.

Primary customers are franchised auto dealerships in the four-state region, which use Dakota Automotive to offer single-item upgrades that would otherwise require a higher trim package from the original equipment manufacturer. Retail consumers in the same territory also purchase directly through the company’s online catalog.

According to the company, its model allows dealerships to sell individual comfort and technology features without forcing buyers into costly package bundles, potentially saving customers thousands of dollars. Dakota Automotive emphasizes product quality, performance, and warranty coverage to ensure satisfaction.

name: Dana Poly Corp.
old_description: Plastic Bags & Custom Packaging Solutions That Protect and Represent Your Products
about:
Dana Poly Corp., headquartered in Dover, New Jersey, has been producing polyethylene film, bags, and sheeting since 1990. The company operates a manufacturing facility that receives plastic resin via a dedicated rail siding, feeding two large storage silos, and has been partially powered by solar energy since 2017.

Its product line includes bin liners, box liners, drum liners, gaylord liners, pallet covers, furniture and mattress bags, anti-static bags, construction sheeting, and a variety of specialty tubing and sheeting. The facility features multiple loading bays for high-volume shipments and an on-site quality control lab that conducts raw material, in-process, and product performance testing.

Dana Poly serves industries such as textiles, carpet, furniture, bedding, construction, and electronics packaging, supplying products like carpet bags, furniture covers, bed bug bags, anti-static bags, and hexene bags. Its customer base includes packaging buyers seeking combined value, service, and dependability.

The company emphasizes its HACCP and GMP certifications, rail logistics that reduce material costs, solar-powered operations, and fast turnaround times as key differentiators.

old_description: Danco Medical Systems has specialized in pharmacy and laboratory design, workflow, and modular casework since 1972. Our design expertise and modular solutions will maximize your workspace and create an efficient environment conducive to your individual department’s needs.
about:
Danco Medical Systems, a family-owned business based in Tipp City, Ohio, was founded in 1962. The company has specialized in pharmacy and laboratory design, workflow, and modular casework since 1972, building a reputation for creating efficient workspaces for healthcare facilities.

The firm provides design and equipment services for hospital pharmacies, including modular casework, IV hoods, USP 797/800 compliant cleanrooms, room sanitization systems, pharmacy cabinets, refrigerator/freezers, carts, and medication carousels. Danco has been involved in the design and equipping of hundreds of facilities, supporting unit dose programs and pharmacy automation projects.

Its customers span medical and dental offices, hospitals, pharmacies, and laboratories. Concrete projects include hospital pharmacy design in Ohio, USP Chapter 797 and 800 compliance solutions, and pharmacy fixture installations for individual department needs.

The company states its mission is to provide cost-effective, high-quality medical, pharmaceutical, and laboratory products, design, and services at the customer's convenience, leveraging decades of design experience to deliver efficient, cost-effective solutions.

old_description: Ethically sourced from the trusted farmers, Danfe’s Chana Dal is made with the finest quality grains with no added colors, preservatives, pesticides or chemicals. Enriched with the goodness of protein, antioxidants, and magnesium, Chana dal is known to be diabetic friendly, improve digestion, boost energy, lower blood pressure, improve your heart health and more. This wholesome lentil can be used to make hearty soups, dals, delectable sweets and rice dishes that fill your home with authentic taste and flavorful aroma.
about:
Danfe Foods operates from Harrisburg, Pennsylvania. The company was established by a leadership team that includes CEO Khada Dulal and Managing Director Krishna Dulal, who were motivated by a passion for natural, unadulterated food. While the exact founding year is not publicly disclosed, the business began with a mission to bring ethically sourced, high-quality grains and spices to families.

The company produces a range of shelf-stable food products across four categories: lentils and beans (such as Chana Dal), flour (including Chakki Fresh Atta), spices (such as White Sesame Seeds), and ready-to-cook items like uncooked Pani Puri. Danfe emphasizes ethical sourcing directly from farms and hygienic packaging designed to preserve freshness and nutrients without additives, colors, preservatives, pesticides, or chemicals.

Danfe sells directly to consumers through its online store, serving households seeking natural, diabetic-friendly, and protein-rich ingredients. Customer testimonials highlight repeat orders and satisfaction with packaging quality and delivery speed. The company also operates under the entity Indigo Foods USA LLC at the same Harrisburg address, suggesting a combined manufacturing and distribution operation.

Danfe differentiates itself by committing to purity at every step: sourcing from farmers, avoiding any adulteration, and packaging in a way that maintains the food’s natural goodness. The brand’s philosophy centers on preserving nature’s integrity, as reflected in its tagline 'Purity preserved' and its dedication to providing unadulterated, wholesome products.

about:
Darlington Snacks, a family-owned commercial bakery, has operated from Indianapolis, Indiana since its founding in 1982. The privately held company has been passed down through generations, building a reputation for pre-baked, packaged snacks sold under the Appleways, Darlington, and Crave-N-Rave brands.

The bakery produces more than 70 varieties of cookies, crackers, bars, fruit snacks, and breakfast items, all individually wrapped and shelf-stable from a dedicated nut-free facility. A dedicated team continuously develops and tests new recipes to meet evolving customer preferences.

Primary customers include daycare centers, K-12 schools, and healthcare facilities. For daycares, the company offers CACFP-certified snacks; for schools, Buy American Certified products that are nut-free, egg-free, and free of artificial flavors, colors, and preservatives; for healthcare, dye-free, nut-free items suited for patient trays and on-the-go service.

Darlington emphasizes innovation and convenience, positioning its "Simply Smart Snacks" as tasty, nut-free, and ready to serve. The company states it never settles for less than a delightful snacking experience, combining safety, freshness, and flavor in every product.
